snippet.title: Post Office: Tidy Up! - Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Post Office: Tidy Up! on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5166890/Post_Office_Tidy_Up/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=teaser

You run a post office and you have to shelve 3,360 parcels into their own numbered slots by courier and country.
